# FileDrop

> A drop zone and file picker with type and size checks and per-file status chips.

Category: Forms. Docs page: https://rime.mjsons.net/components/file-drop

## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add <owner>/rime/file-drop
```

FileDrop validates type and size client-side, lists files as FileChips with uploading, done and error states, and keeps a real file input for keyboard users.

## Usage

```tsx
import { FileDrop } from "@/components/ui";

<FileDrop files={files} onFilesChange={setFiles} accept={[".pdf"]} multiple={false} />
```

| `forceDragOver` | `boolean` | `false` | Holds the drag-over state without a drag. For the styleguide only. |

## Accessibility

- The "Choose files" button opens the native picker; drag and drop is an enhancement, never the only way.

## Do

- State the accepted types and size limit in description.

## Don't

- Don't trust the client check; validate on the server too.
